topic: Que es MCP y por que cambia tu negocio con IA
hook: Tu IA es un genio encerrado en una caja.
cta: Comenta MCP y te paso la guia. Cual conectarias primero? Sigueme para la parte 2.
music_prompt: elegant minimal tech underscore, soft pulsing synth, subtle beat, modern, no vocals

beats.subtitle: Tu IA no toca nada tuyo
beats.scene: a glowing AI brain trapped inside a sealed glass display box on a museum pedestal, dramatic spotlight

beats.subtitle: Pero no ejecuta nada
beats.scene: a robot behind iron prison bars reaching toward a calendar, a sales chart and a database it cannot touch

beats.subtitle: Copiar, pegar, repetir
beats.scene: an exhausted entrepreneur at a cluttered desk at night copy-pasting between many glowing screens

beats.subtitle: Conecta tu IA a tu mundo
beats.scene: a glowing AI brain violently shattering out of a glass box, shards and energy bursting outward

beats.subtitle: Cero codigo por cada app
beats.scene: a central glowing hub with one universal cable connecting to dozens of app icons arranged around it

beats.subtitle: Agenda, responde, reporta
beats.scene: a friendly retro robot at an office desk with many arms autonomously handling a calendar, envelopes and paper reports, no signs

beats.subtitle: Enchufas y funciona
beats.scene: a giant USB connector plugging into a glowing brain-shaped port, retro tech poster style

beats.subtitle: Y te mando la guia gratis
beats.scene: a warm cozy desk scene with a large glowing comment speech bubble and a phone inviting engagement
